notes.title: Age of Empires: Definitive Edition - Update 100.2.31845.0
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210610/1e2c052f080e42dfa57e5c2683c60703578b7bff.jpg[/img]
[i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i] is receiving a pre-emptive update to ensure online features continue to function as intended and remain compatible with current and future server updates.
 
We are switching our API's domain to aoe-api.worldsedgelink.com. This domain change was already made for [i]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition[/i], [i]Age of Empires III: Definitive Edition[/i], [i]Age of Empires IV[/i], and is now coming to [i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i].
 
We're also removing the requirement to perform a (platform) login to access the /community/ APIs.
 
[h1]FAQ[/h1]
[h3][u]What does this mean for me?[/u][/h3]
If you're using any of the current APIs, you'll have to switch the domain for your services to aoe-api.worldsedgelink.com. The endpoints and arguments can remain the same. We'll update you if those change.

If you're currently using a login to access the /community/ APIs, you will no longer need to. This does mean that rate limiting will be done on a per-IP basis, rather than a per-user basis.

[h3][u]By when do we have to make this change?[/u][/h3]
The current domain will stay functional until at least January 31st.

As mentioned above, you will no longer have to log in to access community APIs.

[h3][u]What about the ageofempires.com APIs?[/u][/h3]
Those are managed by World's Edge and will be maintained as they are.

notes.title: Age of Empires: Definitive Edition — Update 46777
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210610/6063553bbe35d86fb4c6832bbb1081c504393157.png[/img]

Hello warriors of rogan, priests of the almighty wololo, and masters of the ancient world!

Today, we’re excited to package up a long-awaited delivery of bug fixes and balance changes for you to enjoy in[i] Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i]. This full change log is short enough to skip a tl;dr version, but it’s worth noting that the main focus of this month’s release is on the playability of the game and spectating experience. Check out the full notes, below!

We fully recognize that there is more you’d like to see from [i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i], and we’ve already captured some of the most prominent discussion points for future consideration. Your voices have been key in identifying the fixes and features we’ll be working on for the game, and we want to continue encouraging you to use your voice! Whether you’d like to see gameplay improvements, new features, or have a list ready to go, we want to hear about them over on our official channels.

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1017900/discussions/]Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition Forum[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
We hope you enjoy today’s release, and look forward to hearing more about what you’d like to see in [i]Age: DE[/i].

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team


[hr][/hr][code][h1]         ◆ UPDATE 46777 ◆[/h1][/code][hr][/hr]
[h1][b]GAME[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] Fixed an issue where game chat sent to ALL players (using “[b]*[/b]“) would not be visible for Player 8.
[*] Fixed several problems with the presentation of the [b]Statistics – Timeline[/b].
[/list]

[h1][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] [b]Ruins[/b] and [b]Artifacts[/b] can no longer be moved using the [b]Shift + Delete[/b] key.
[*] Fixed remaining instances where units could be spawned on the opposite side of a wall by placing their production building adjacent to the wall.
[*] Fixed several pathfinding bugs which would cause units to occasionally get stuck in each other’s models.
[*] Fixed an issue where using [b]Stand Ground[/b] and [b]Attack Move[/b] could cause units be stuck in one location while playing their attack animation.
[*] Fixed some equally-odd behaviors when setting a unit to [b]Defensive Stance[/b] and issuing an [b]Attack Move[/b] command.
[*] Units set to [b]Stand Ground[/b] will now chase targeted units when manually tasked to attack them.
[*] Units set to [b]Defensive Stance[/b] will no longer return to their previous location when manually tasked to attack a unit or building.
[*] Using the [b]Shift + Delete[/b] command to cancel unfinished buildings will now properly refund their cost.
[*] Changing a unit’s stance to [b]No Attack[/b] will now properly interrupt the unit’s current attack.
[*] Implemented countermeasures for numerous cheat exploits.
[/list]

[h1][b]CIVILIZATION BALANCE[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 UNITS[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Ballista:[/b] Increased attack speed by [b]+15%[/b].
[*] [b]Elephant Archer:[/b] Reverted [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1017900/view/2542794099151308137]previous changes[/url] to damage by increasing it from [b]5 ▶ 6[/b].
[*] [b]Elephant Archer:[/b] Increased gold cost from [b]45 ▶ 60 gold[/b], which restores the original game value. The food cost remains the same (180 food).
[*] [b]Helepolis:[/b] Reduced the upgrade cost from [b]1500 ▶ 1200 food[/b]. The wood cost remains the same (1000 wood).
[*] [b]Helepolis:[/b] Increased attack from [b]40 ▶ 45[/b].
[*] [b]Legion:[/b] Reduced health from [b]160 ▶ 140[/b].
[/list]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Long Sword:[/b] Increased the upgrade cost from [b]160 food, 50 gold ▶ 240 food, 100 gold[/b].
[/list]
[h3][b]Assyrians[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Alchemy:[/b] Now have access to the technology!
[/list]
[h3][b]Babylonians[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
The Babylonians now have access to all [b]Chain Mail[/b] technologies. This includes:
[list]
[*] [b]Chain Mail Archers[/b]
[*] [b]Chain Mail Cavalry[/b]
[*] [b]Chain Mail Infantry[/b]
[/list]
[h3][b]Shang[/b][/h3]
[b]🡒 TECHNOLOGIES[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Ballistics:[/b] Now have access to the technology!
[/list]

[h1][b]LOBBIES & MATCHMAKING[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][h3][b]General[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue which would cause the [b]Solid Farms[/b] setting to default to [b]“On”[/b] for some players.
[*] Fixed an issue where the [b]Team Together[/b] option might fail to place players in the proper positions while spectators were also present in the game.
[/list]
[h3][b]Spectating[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Added an indicator next to the player names in the scoreboard and selection panel denoting which player you are currently spectating.
[/list]
The spectator hotkeys, [b]1-8[/b], will now correspond to the [b]Player Colors[/b]. This means that:
[list]
[*] Pressing [b]1[/b] will always display the resources and global queue of the [b]Blue[/b] player
[*] Pressing [b]2[/b] will display the resources and global queue of the [b]Red[/b] player
[*] [b]3 = Yellow[/b]
[*] [b]4 = Brown[/b]
[*] [b]5 = Orange[/b]
[*] [b]6 = Green[/b]
[*] [b]7 = Magenta[/b]
[*] [b]8 = Cyan[/b]
[/list]

[h1][b]LOCALIZATION[/b][/h1][hr]
[/hr][list]
[*] Updated game strings to reflect all balance changes made over the last several updates.
[/list]

notes.title: Age of Empires: Definitive Edition — Update 38862
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210610/292d89efd1c9cfa717b83420bc747dc581d10034.png[/img]

IT’S HERE! [i]Age of Empires[/i] fans rejoice: a new update and new ways to play Age are upon us! The Priests are here to spread the word, and everyone can chant along to the [i]♪ wolooolooooo ♪[/i].

Today’s release comes with a huge list of changes for the classic RTS title: including a boatload of balance adjustments, improvements to many of your favorite civilizations, the return of several features from the classic [i]Age of Empires[/i] experience, and several brand-new systems to continue the ongoing evolution of the game! Here are some of the highlights:
[list][*] [b]New unit stances![/b]
[*] [b]New & improved matchmaking lobby: new chat shortcuts, mirrored civilization picks, and more![/b]
[*] [b]Reorganized ranked ladders (paired with a ladder reset)![/b]
[*] [b]Balance updates to maps, units, and civilizations![/b]
[*] [b]Reduced install size from ~17GB to ~12GB![/b]
[*] [b]Anti-cheat improvements![/b]
[*] [i]...and more![/i][/list]
As always, we want to hear about your experience as you jump into Update 38862! Be sure to visit our official channels to talk with the team and become a part of the community!

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1017900/eventcomments/]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition - Update 38862 Discussion[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
Enjoy the latest update and as always: keep those Wonders building!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[h1][b]▬▬▬ UPDATE 38862 ▬▬▬[/b][/h1]

[h1]◆ NEW CONTENT & FEATURES ◆[/h1][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aoede_unit_stances.png[/img]
[list][*] New [b]unit stances[/b] are available—similar to those in Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition.
[list][*] Aggressive (Default)
[*] Defensive
[*] Stand Ground
[*] No Attack[/list]
[*] A new [b]Mirror Civilization[/b] option is available in multiplayer lobbies, allowing you to match the civilization of your opponent.[/list]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aoede_patch_new_solid_farms-1080x508.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Added a new [b]Solid Farms (Legacy)[/b] setting. When enabled, farms act as solid buildings (like the original game) that block movement until the farm is destroyed.
[*] New hotkeys have been added to support the following actions:
[list][*] Select all buildings of the same type (Ctrl + Shift + key)
[*] Select all idle villagers [Ctrl + Shift + .]
[*] Select all military units [Ctrl + Shift + ,]
[*] Delete all selected units [Shift + Delete]
[*] Reset zoom to default level (100%) [Ctrl + Alt + 0][/list]
[*] Implemented several new [b]anti-cheat[/b] measures to keep things honest and fair![/list]
[h1]◆ MULTIPLAYER ◆[/h1]
[list][*] The [b]Team[/b] ranked lobby option is no longer locked and can be used to create 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4 matches.
[*] Quickmatch and ranked lobbies now share the same Elo ladders.
[*] Elo ladders are now split into [b]1v1[/b] and [b]Team[/b] ladders for both the [b]Random Map[/b] and [b]Deathmatch[/b] ranked modes. Quickmatch is still divided into 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4, but the latter three (2v2, 3v3, 4v4) count towards your [b]Team[/b] Elo.
[*] Leaderboards will now display the Elo values for all players.[/list]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aoede_patch_new_leaderboards-1080x608.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Ranked games should no longer end up with unevenly-distributed teams.
[*] Options used when creating a ranked lobby will no longer remain as a filter following the game.
[*] The default team for both the host and clients in a lobby is now set to [b]random[/b].
[*] Fixed a bug that caused random teams to create unbalanced teams.
[*] Players will no longer be un-readied when another player in the lobby changes their team or color.
[*] Lobby chat can now be scrolled using the mouse wheel.
[*] Updated the message when kicking someone from a lobby to properly display the player's name.
[*] Added a new countdown before a match begins.
[*] Added chat shortcuts to send a message to specific players within a match: [b]Allies[/b] (;), [b]Enemies[/b] (#), and [b]All[/b] (*)
[*] Chat will no longer be displayed for the enemy team when co-op players are in a match.
[*] Chat will no longer break after displaying a multi-line message.
[*] Spectators can now see player resources and the global queue for each player by using the number keys (1-8).[/list]
[h1]◆ GAME ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]STABILITY & PERFORMANCE[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an uncommon issue that caused some users to disconnect approximately 5 minutes after starting a match.
[*] Implemented general performance optimizations.[/list]
[h3][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][list][*] Fixed an unintended mechanic where units could be spawned on the opposite side of a wall built next to the production building.
[*] Units will no longer be created from blocked buildings that have no valid space for the unit to spawn.
[*] Military units will no longer lose their collision boxes or stack/merge together when grouped closely or forced into a tight space.
[*] Fixed rare instances where [b]Ballistics[/b] would fail to properly improve the accuracy of the Catapult Trireme or Juggernaught.
[*] Using [b]Attack Move[/b] with [b]Priests[/b] in the selection group will no longer inspire them to try and convert enemy units who enter their line of sight.
[*] Villagers will no longer automatically hunt another nearby Elephant after gathering all the food from the first.
[*] Naval units will no longer get stuck in Docks where they are created.
[*] Left-clicking to execute a command will now work even when moving the cursor while clicking.
[*] Implemented global pathfinding improvements.[/list]
[h3][b]GRAPHICS[/b][/h3][list][*] Graphics assets now use a compressed format in order to reduce the overall size of the game and new updates.
[list][*] Implemented additional installation optimizations to reduce the hard drive space required by the game.
[*] [b]NOTE:[/b] These changes will require an (initially) larger download than normal to download the new files. This will reduce the size of future downloads.[/list]
[*] Adjusted the speed of certain unit animations in order to appear more realistic.
[*] The selection outlines for units and buildings are not properly scaled at all zoom levels.
[*] Implemented minor changes to some unit animations in order to appear more realistic.
[*] Slowed the destruction animations of buildings to more reasonable levels.
[*] Units now decay and disappear from the battlefield more rapidly.[/list]
[h3][b]AUDIO[/b][/h3][list][*] Adjusted in-game sounds to a more consistent volume level.[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*] Increased the maximum zoom threshold in multiplayer to match that of single player.
[*] Renamed the [b]Black Map Fog[/b] option to [b]Animate Fog[/b] in order to better clarify its purpose.
[*] Players are now sorted by Team on the [b]Statistics - Timeline[/b] screen.[/list]
[h1]◆ CIVILIZATION BALANCE ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]GENERAL[/b][/h3][list][*] Villagers now move [b]10%[/b] faster in the Tool Age. The [b]Wheel[/b] technology now grants a [b]+50%[/b] speed boost (was +60%) to maintain the same maximum speed.
[*] [b]Warships[/b] and [b]Slingers[/b] no longer deal a minimum of 1 damage to buildings. This reduces the damage dealt by Slingers against normal buildings and by Scout Ships against walls and towers.
[*] Decreased the maximum search radius of [b]Priests[/b] to prevent them from fixating on and following distant injured units.
[*] Predator animals will no longer break off their attack if you try to drop a building on them.
[*] [b]Cataphract:[/b] Now have [b]+20 hp[/b], [b]+1 armor[/b], and [b]+2 attack vs. infantry[/b] (for a total of 7).
[*] [b]Cataphract:[/b] Reduced the gold cost of the upgrade from [b]750[/b] to [b]600 gold[/b]. The food cost is unchanged.
[*] [b]Domestication:[/b] Reduced the food cost to research the technology from [b]200[/b] to [b]150 food[/b]. The wood cost is unchanged.
[*] [b]Heavy Cavalry:[/b] Now have [b]+1 attack vs. infantry[/b] (for a total of 6).
[*] [b]Helepolis:[/b] Increased the fire rate by [b]5%[/b] (still slower than that in the original game).
[*] [b]Scout:[/b] Increased cost from [b]80[/b] to [b]90 food[/b]. (This is still lower than the 100 food cost in the original game.)
[*] [b]Scout:[/b] Reduced line of sight by [b]1[/b].
[*] [b]Scythe Chariot:[/b] Reduced armor from [b]2[/b] to [b]1[/b].
[*] [b]Scythe Chariot:[/b] Increased the upgrade cost from [b]1200 wood, 800 gold[/b] to [b]1400 wood, 1000 gold[/b].
[*] [b]Scythe Chariot:[/b] Increased the time to research the unit from [b]150[/b] to [b]200 seconds[/b].
[*] Chariot units no longer deal bonus damage to Priests.
[*] Reduced the conversion resistance of all Chariot units from [b]8x[/b] to [b]2x[/b] that of normal units.
[*] [b]Siegecraft:[/b] Reduced the attack bonus granted to Villagers vs. towers and walls by ~50%.
[*] [b]Slinger:[/b] Increased the training time from [b]28[/b] to [b]35 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Slinger:[/b] Reduced damage dealt to walls and towers by ~50%.
[*] Towers: Increased the hp of all towers: Watch Tower (+25 hp), Sentry Tower (+35 hp), Guard Tower (+40 hp), Ballista Tower (+40 hp).[/list]
Several units and technologies have had attributes adjusted to match their original game values:
[list][*] [b]Bowman:[/b] Increased the training time from [b]26[/b] to [b]30 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Coinage:[/b] Increased the amount of bonus gold yielded from nodes from [b]+10%[/b] to [b]+25%[/b].
[*] [b]Camel Rider:[/b] Reduced training time from [b]32[/b] to [b]30 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Elephant Archer:[/b] Reduced attack damage from [b]6[/b] to [b]5[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]BABYLONIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Market technologies are 30% cheaper to research.
[*] Decreased the bonus hp of walls and towers from [b]+75%[/b] to [b]+60% hp[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]CARTHAGINIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Carthaginians now start the game with [b]+50[/b] of each resource.[/list]
[h3][b]CHOSON[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Storage Pit technologies are [b]40%[/b] cheaper to research.[/list]
[h3][b]EGYPTIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Farms are 20% cheaper to build; they now cost [b]60 wood[/b] instead of [b]75 wood[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]GREEK[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Town Centers work 10% faster starting in the Tool Age. This affects both Villager creation and aging up.
[*] Now have access to the [b]Fire Galley[/b] naval unit.[/list]
[h3][b]HITTITES[/b][/h3][list][*] Rather than having +3 range at all times, Hittite warships now have [b]+2 range[/b] in the Tool Age and [b]+3 range[/b] in the Bronze and Iron Age.[/list]
[h3][b]MACEDONIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Rather than having +2 pierce armor at all times, Macedonian Academy units now have [b]+1 pierce armor[/b] in the Bronze Age and [b]+2 pierce armor[/b] in the Iron Age.[/list]
[h3][b]PALMYRANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Increased the civilization starting food bonus from [b]+50[/b] to [b]+75 food[/b].
[*] Now have access to the [b]Plow[/b] technology.[/list]
[h3][b]PERSIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Increased the movement speed of Persian Elephant units from [b]+20%[/b] to [b]+25%[/b] that of other elephants.
[*] Now have access to the [b]Plow[/b] technology.[/list]
[h3][b]ROMANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Reduced the civilization discount to Tower costs from [b]-50%[/b] to [b]-40%[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]SHANG[/b][/h3][list][*] Reduced the civilization bonus to Wall hp from [b]+75%[/b] to [b]+60% hp[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]YAMATO[/b][/h3][list][*] Reduced the civilization discount to Cavalry unit costs from [b]-20%[/b] to [b]-15%[/b].
[*] Reduced the civilization bonus to Ship hp from [b]+25%[/b] to [b]+20% hp[/b].[/list]
[h1]◆ MAP BALANCE ◆[/h1]
[list][*] Increased the quantity of gold in node tiles from [b]400[/b] to [b]450 gold[/b].
[*] Increased the quantity of stone in node tiles from [b]250[/b] to [b]300 stone[/b].
[*] Maps now guarantee that one straggler tree spawns near the Town Center of each player on all maps. Additional straggler trees are random, as before.
[*] Increased the amount of gold generated on maps. Most maps now have [b]3[/b] piles of gold per player except for the Continental and Narrows maps, which have [b]2[/b] larger piles.
[*] Adjusted how maps are generated to ensure that the same amount of gold and stone spawns in each pile for each player.
[*] Lions will no longer spawn in pairs. There is still a small chance for two lions to spawn relatively close to each other, but that's entirely random.
[*] [b]Continental:[/b] Slightly increased the forested area.
[*] [b]Small / Large Islands:[/b] Increased the amount of forest that spawns on the island.
[*] [b]Small / Large Islands:[/b] Non-player gold nodes have been replaced with another player gold.
[*] [b]Small Islands:[/b] Increased the size of the islands.
[*] [b]Small Islands:[/b] Increased the number of resources that spawn on each island, as well as shore fish and deep sea fish.
[*] [b]Oasis:[/b] Reduced the amount of water and increased the amount of forest spawned at the center of the map.
[*] Other minor map improvements.[/list]

Here's just a few of the highlights to which to look forward in [b]Update 38862:[/b]
[list][*] [b]New unit stances![/b]
[*] [b]New & improved matchmaking lobby: new chat shortcuts, mirrored civilization picks, and more![/b]
[*] [b]Reorganized ranked ladders (paired with a ladder reset)![/b]
[*] [b]Balance updates to maps, units, and civilizations![/b]
[*] [b]Reduced install size from ~17GB to ~12GB![/b]

Even though we're still working through the final steps to make the build available next week, you can check out the full list of what's coming your way below! Give them a read, then feel free to discuss them over on any of our official channels!

[quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1017900/eventcomments/]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition - Update 36211 Discussion[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]
We still have a long list of changes, improvements, and features still in the works—many of which are based on feedback and ideas from the community! Keep it coming our way, and let us know how Update 38862 feels when it finally drops next week!

Keep those Wonders building!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[h1][b]▬▬▬ UPDATE 38862 ▬▬▬[/b][/h1]

[h1]◆ NEW CONTENT & FEATURES ◆[/h1][img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aoede_unit_stances.png[/img]
[list][*] New [b]unit stances[/b] are available—similar to those in Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition.
[list][*] Aggressive (Default)
[*] Defensive
[*] Stand Ground
[*] No Attack[/list]
[*] A new [b]Mirror Civilization[/b] option is available in multiplayer lobbies, allowing you to match the civilization of your opponent.[/list]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aoede_patch_new_solid_farms-1080x508.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Added a new [b]Solid Farms (Legacy)[/b] setting. When enabled, farms act as solid buildings (like the original game) that block movement until the farm is destroyed.
[*] New hotkeys have been added to support the following actions:
[list][*] Select all buildings of the same type (Ctrl + Shift + key)
[*] Select all idle villagers [Ctrl + Shift + .]
[*] Select all military units [Ctrl + Shift + ,]
[*] Delete all selected units [Shift + Delete]
[*] Reset zoom to default level (100%) [Ctrl + Alt + 0][/list]
[*] Implemented several new [b]anti-cheat[/b] measures to keep things honest and fair![/list]
[h1]◆ MULTIPLAYER ◆[/h1]
[list][*] The [b]Team[/b] ranked lobby option is no longer locked and can be used to create 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4 matches.
[*] Quickmatch and ranked lobbies now share the same Elo ladders.
[*] Elo ladders are now split into [b]1v1[/b] and [b]Team[/b] ladders for both the [b]Random Map[/b] and [b]Deathmatch[/b] ranked modes. Quickmatch is still divided into 1v1, 2v2, 3v3, and 4v4, but the latter three (2v2, 3v3, 4v4) count towards your [b]Team[/b] Elo.
[*] Leaderboards will now display the Elo values for all players.[/list]
[img]https://static.ageofempires.com/aoe/wp-content/uploads/2020/07/aoede_patch_new_leaderboards-1080x608.jpg[/img]
[list][*] Ranked games should no longer end up with unevenly-distributed teams.
[*] Options used when creating a ranked lobby will no longer remain as a filter following the game.
[*] The default team for both the host and clients in a lobby is now set to [b]random[/b].
[*] Fixed a bug that caused random teams to create unbalanced teams.
[*] Players will no longer be un-readied when another player in the lobby changes their team or color.
[*] Lobby chat can now be scrolled using the mouse wheel.
[*] Updated the message when kicking someone from a lobby to properly display the player's name.
[*] Added a new countdown before a match begins.
[*] Added chat shortcuts to send a message to specific players within a match: [b]Allies[/b] (;), [b]Enemies[/b] (#), and [b]All[/b] (*)
[*] Chat will no longer be displayed for the enemy team when co-op players are in a match.
[*] Chat will no longer break after displaying a multi-line message.
[*] Spectators can now see player resources and the global queue for each player by using the number keys (1-8).[/list]
[h1]◆ GAME ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]STABILITY & PERFORMANCE[/b][/h3]
[list][*] Fixed an uncommon issue that caused some users to disconnect approximately 5 minutes after starting a match.
[*] Implemented general performance optimizations.[/list]
[h3][b]GAMEPLAY[/b][/h3][list][*] Fixed an unintended mechanic where units could be spawned on the opposite side of a wall built next to the production building.
[*] Units will no longer be created from blocked buildings that have no valid space for the unit to spawn.
[*] Military units will no longer lose their collision boxes or stack/merge together when grouped closely or forced into a tight space.
[*] Fixed rare instances where [b]Ballistics[/b] would fail to properly improve the accuracy of the Catapult Trireme or Juggernaught.
[*] Using [b]Attack Move[/b] with [b]Priests[/b] in the selection group will no longer inspire them to try and convert enemy units who enter their line of sight.
[*] Villagers will no longer automatically hunt another nearby Elephant after gathering all the food from the first.
[*] Naval units will no longer get stuck in Docks where they are created.
[*] Left-clicking to execute a command will now work even when moving the cursor while clicking.
[*] Implemented global pathfinding improvements.[/list]
[h3][b]GRAPHICS[/b][/h3][list][*] Graphics assets now use a compressed format in order to reduce the overall size of the game and new updates.
[list][*] Implemented additional installation optimizations to reduce the hard drive space required by the game.
[*] [b]NOTE:[/b] These changes will require an (initially) larger download than normal to download the new files. This will reduce the size of future downloads.[/list]
[*] Adjusted the speed of certain unit animations in order to appear more realistic.
[*] The selection outlines for units and buildings are not properly scaled at all zoom levels.
[*] Implemented minor changes to some unit animations in order to appear more realistic.
[*] Slowed the destruction animations of buildings to more reasonable levels.
[*] Units now decay and disappear from the battlefield more rapidly.[/list]
[h3][b]AUDIO[/b][/h3][list][*] Adjusted in-game sounds to a more consistent volume level.[/list]
[h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*] Increased the maximum zoom threshold in multiplayer to match that of single player.
[*] Renamed the [b]Black Map Fog[/b] option to [b]Animate Fog[/b] in order to better clarify its purpose.
[*] Players are now sorted by Team on the [b]Statistics - Timeline[/b] screen.[/list]
[h1]◆ CIVILIZATION BALANCE ◆[/h1]
[h3][b]GENERAL[/b][/h3][list][*] Villagers now move [b]10%[/b] faster in the Tool Age. The [b]Wheel[/b] technology now grants a [b]+50%[/b] speed boost (was +60%) to maintain the same maximum speed.
[*] [b]Warships[/b] and [b]Slingers[/b] no longer deal a minimum of 1 damage to buildings. This reduces the damage dealt by Slingers against normal buildings and by Scout Ships against walls and towers.
[*] Decreased the maximum search radius of [b]Priests[/b] to prevent them from fixating on and following distant injured units.
[*] Predator animals will no longer break off their attack if you try to drop a building on them.
[*] [b]Cataphract:[/b] Now have [b]+20 hp[/b], [b]+1 armor[/b], and [b]+2 attack vs. infantry[/b] (for a total of 7).
[*] [b]Cataphract:[/b] Reduced the gold cost of the upgrade from [b]750[/b] to [b]600 gold[/b]. The food cost is unchanged.
[*] [b]Domestication:[/b] Reduced the food cost to research the technology from [b]200[/b] to [b]150 food[/b]. The wood cost is unchanged.
[*] [b]Heavy Cavalry:[/b] Now have [b]+1 attack vs. infantry[/b] (for a total of 6).
[*] [b]Helepolis:[/b] Increased the fire rate by [b]5%[/b] (still slower than that in the original game).
[*] [b]Scout:[/b] Increased cost from [b]80[/b] to [b]90 food[/b]. (This is still lower than the 100 food cost in the original game.)
[*] [b]Scout:[/b] Reduced line of sight by [b]1[/b].
[*] [b]Scythe Chariot:[/b] Reduced armor from [b]2[/b] to [b]1[/b].
[*] [b]Scythe Chariot:[/b] Increased the upgrade cost from [b]1200 wood, 800 gold[/b] to [b]1400 wood, 1000 gold[/b].
[*] [b]Scythe Chariot:[/b] Increased the time to research the unit from [b]150[/b] to [b]200 seconds[/b].
[*] Chariot units no longer deal bonus damage to Priests.
[*] Reduced the conversion resistance of all Chariot units from [b]8x[/b] to [b]2x[/b] that of normal units.
[*] [b]Siegecraft:[/b] Reduced the attack bonus granted to Villagers vs. towers and walls by ~50%.
[*] [b]Slinger:[/b] Increased the training time from [b]28[/b] to [b]35 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Slinger:[/b] Reduced damage dealt to walls and towers by ~50%.
[*] Towers: Increased the hp of all towers: Watch Tower (+25 hp), Sentry Tower (+35 hp), Guard Tower (+40 hp), Ballista Tower (+40 hp).[/list]
Several units and technologies have had attributes adjusted to match their original game values:
[list][*] [b]Bowman:[/b] Increased the training time from [b]26[/b] to [b]30 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Coinage:[/b] Increased the amount of bonus gold yielded from nodes from [b]+10%[/b] to [b]+25%[/b].
[*] [b]Camel Rider:[/b] Reduced training time from [b]32[/b] to [b]30 seconds[/b].
[*] [b]Elephant Archer:[/b] Reduced attack damage from [b]6[/b] to [b]5[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]BABYLONIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Market technologies are 30% cheaper to research.
[*] Decreased the bonus hp of walls and towers from [b]+75%[/b] to [b]+60% hp[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]CARTHAGINIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Carthaginians now start the game with [b]+50[/b] of each resource.[/list]
[h3][b]CHOSON[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Storage Pit technologies are [b]40%[/b] cheaper to research.[/list]
[h3][b]EGYPTIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Farms are 20% cheaper to build; they now cost [b]60 wood[/b] instead of [b]75 wood[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]GREEK[/b][/h3][list][*] [b]New Civilization Bonus![/b] Town Centers work 10% faster stating in the Tool Age. This affects both Villager creation and aging up.
[*] Now have access to the [b]Fire Galley[/b] naval unit.[/list]
[h3][b]HITTITES[/b][/h3][list][*] Rather than having +3 range at all times, Hittite warships now have [b]+2 range[/b] in the Tool Age and [b]+3 range[/b] in the Bronze and Iron Age.[/list]
[h3][b]MACEDONIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Rather than having +2 pierce armor at all times, Macedonian Academy units now have [b]+1 pierce armor[/b] in the Bronze Age and [b]+2 pierce armor[/b] in the Iron Age.[/list]
[h3][b]PALMYRANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Increased the civilization starting food bonus from [b]+50[/b] to [b]+75 food[/b].
[*] Now have access to the [b]Plow[/b] technology.[/list]
[h3][b]PERSIANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Increased the movement speed of Persian Elephant units from [b]+20%[/b] to [b]+25%[/b] that of other elephants.
[*] Now have access to the [b]Plow[/b] technology.[/list]
[h3][b]ROMANS[/b][/h3][list][*] Reduced the civilization discount to Tower costs from [b]-50%[/b] to [b]-40%[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]SHANG[/b][/h3][list][*] Reduced the civilization bonus to Wall hp from [b]+75%[/b] to [b]+60% hp[/b].[/list]
[h3][b]YAMATO[/b][/h3][list][*] Reduced the civilization discount to Cavalry unit costs from [b]-20%[/b] to [b]-15%[/b].
[*] Reduced the civilization bonus to Ship hp from [b]+25%[/b] to [b]+20% hp[/b].[/list]
[h1]◆ MAP BALANCE ◆[/h1]
[list][*] Increased the quantity of gold in node tiles from [b]400[/b] to [b]450 gold[/b].
[*] Increased the quantity of stone in node tiles from [b]250[/b] to [b]300 stone[/b].
[*] Maps now guarantee that one straggler tree spawns near the Town Center of each player on all maps. Additional straggler trees are random, as before.
[*] Increased the amount of gold generated on maps. Most maps now have [b]3[/b] piles of gold per player except for the Continental and Narrows maps, which have [b]2[/b] larger piles.
[*] Adjusted how maps are generated to ensure that the same amount of gold and stone spawns in each pile for each player.
[*] Lions will no longer spawn in pairs. There is still a small chance for two lions to spawn relatively close to each other, but that's entirely random.
[*] [b]Continental:[/b] Slightly increased the forested area.
[*] [b]Small / Large Islands:[/b] Increased the amount of forest that spawns on the island.
[*] [b]Small / Large Islands:[/b] Non-player gold nodes have been replaced with another player gold.
[*] [b]Small Islands:[/b] Increased the size of the islands.
[*] [b]Small Islands:[/b] Increased the number of resources that spawn on each island, as well as shore fish and deep sea fish.
[*] [b]Oasis:[/b] Reduced the amount of water and increased the amount of forest spawned at the center of the map.
[*] Other minor map improvements.[/list]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210610/edb2f75dd1764034e6e830eb3e0a95c84ed5488a.png[/img]

Hello brave warriors of history! Today’s update comes with fixes for several crashes reported by players over the past month. [quote] 💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1017900/eventcomments/]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition - Update 35199 Discussion[/url][/quote]

notes.title: Age of Empires: Definitive Edition — Update 34483
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35210610/4bd41145af3d2bd7db1e7ea239d9ceb78023a730.png[/img]

Hello, and welcome to our first [i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i] update of the new year!

Today's build features several crash fixes, performance optimizations, game improvements, and even a few new features that are now available in the game: such as an [b]Eye Candy[/b] slider to modify how much foliage shows up in the game, an [b]ELO pop-up[/b] at the end of ranked matches, and new [b]cross-platform invitations[/b] so you can more easily play with your friends on Steam and the Microsoft Store. Give it a download, then come join our community to talk about your experience or any ideas you have for [i]Age: DE[/i]:

[quote]💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1017900/discussions/]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition (Steam Discussions)[/url]
💬 [b]DISCUSS:[/b] [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/c/age-of-empires-definitive-edition]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition (Official Forum)[/url]
🗣 [b]JOIN:[/b] [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/quote]

[h1][b]------------- UPDATE 34483 -------------[/b][/h1]
[h1]◆ [b]GENERAL[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Implemented several performance optimizations for lower-end systems.
[*] Added a performance setting to select how much [b]Foliage[/b] is displayed in the game. Look for the [b]Eye Candy[/b] option in the settings menu.
[*] Added the ability to send [b]cross-platform invitations[/b] to join a match.
[*] Improved the rate at which game lobby settings communicate and replicate to other clients.[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]GAMEPLAY[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Added a pop-up displaying your [b]ELO changes[/b] following a ranked match.
[/list]
[h1]◆ [b]BUG FIXES[/b] ◆[/h1][list][*] Implemented fixes to address several game crashes.
[*] Fixed an issue which prevented the lobby browser from properly refreshing.
[*] Implemented a potential fix for firewall issues with LAN servers on certain setups.
[*] Improved loading times when starting up the game.
[*] Improved the contrast of text lettering on several screens.
[*] Fixed several minor UI and localization errors.
[/list]

notes.title: Age of Empires: Definitive Edition - Update 28529
notes.notes:
Hello and happy Wednesday to all of our [i]Definitive Edition[/i] adventurers!

[b]Update 28529[/b] is aimed at fixing at some of the more recent pain points you've helped identify over the last few weeks: including issues with the [b]multiplayer lobby[/b] and [b]match setup[/b], [b]villager pathfinding[/b], [b]region selection[/b], and a handful of other areas. Your feedback has been invaluable in helping us identify the issues preventing you from playing or enjoying the game, so be sure to grab the new build, check out the notes below, play with the changes, and—most importantly—let us know whether they've fixed the issues at hand. The best place to do so is on the official game forum:
[list]
[*] [b]DISCUSS: [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1017900/discussions]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition - Update 28529 Discussion[/url][/b]
[/list]
You are also encouraged to come visit us on Discord, where you can organize games, troubleshoot issues, engage with the development team, and interact with other [i]Age of Empires[/i] players:
[list]
[*] [b]JOIN: [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]The Age of Empires Official Discord[/url][/b]
[/list]
We look forward to hearing what you think of [b]Update 28529[/b], and we'll see you on the battlefield!

—The [i]Age of Empires[/i] Team

[code][h1][i]AGE OF EMPIRES: DEFINITIVE EDITION[/i] - UPDATE 28529[/h1][/code]

[h1]◆ GENERAL ◆[/h1]
[list]
    [*] The game no longer auto-pauses when switching focus away from the game.
    [*] Fixed a rare issue that resulted in an ‘Unable to setup storagePoint’ error when launching the game.
[/list]

[h1]◆ GAMEPLAY ◆[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Reduced the collision size of villagers to improve resource collection/pathfinding.
    [*] Ranked games now require even teams before they can be started.
[/list]

[h1]◆ BUG FIXES ◆[/h1]
[list]
    [*] The multiplayer region now correctly defaults to the detected region of the host.
    [*] Fixed an issue where the last player to join a ranked lobby was incorrectly muted.
    [*] Fixed a rare issue where pressing the ESC key would not exit out of the Tech Tree overlay.
[/list]

notes.title: Age of Empires: Definitive Edition - Update 28218
notes.notes:
Hello knights of the [i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i]! It's been less than a day since the official release of the [i]Definitive Edition[/i] on Steam, and the whole community has been awesome at working with us and highlighting the biggest issues impacting your experience. Today's build contains a handful of fixes for some of the biggest and most glaring issues that cropped up with the release build over the past day. Give them a read and let us know if you continue to have issues!

In the meantime, keep taking notes of any issues you encounter; we'll be visiting the Steam boards and official [i]Age of Empires[/i] forum to see what crops up:
[list]
[*] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1017900/discussions][i]Age of Empires: Definitive Edition[/i] Forum[/url]
[*] [url=https://forums.ageofempires.com/]Official [i]Age of Empires[/i] Forums[/url]
[/list]
Remember that you can also join us on [url=https://discord.gg/ageofempires]Discord[/url] to organize games, troubleshoot issues, and interact with the outstanding [i]Age of Empires[/i] community!

Enjoy the update!

[code][h1][i]AGE OF EMPIRES: DEFINITIVE EDITION[/i] - UPDATE 28218[/h1][/code]

[h1]GENERAL[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Fixed an issue where the game would halt due to anti-virus checks.
    [*] Fixed several issues with duplicate region names and region-selection not behaving as expected.
[/list]

[h1]USER INTERFACE (UI)[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Fixed a issue on the campaign completion screens which would cause the text to be overwritten by the statistics buttons.
[/list]

[h1]MULTIPLAYER[/h1]
[list]
    [*] Fixed a crash caused when closing the post-game statistics screen if a spectator was present.
    [*] Improved the behavior of the lobby browser when refreshing the list.
[/list]
